name: Breakout Games - Orange Beach
description: Breakout Games - #1 Escape Room in Orange Beach has thrilling escape rooms with a variety of game themes that are perfect for having fun with your friends, family, or even a team building exercise with your coworkers. Our company is a leader in the escape room industry and you'll experience the difference when you visit us in Orange Beach. We've spent the last 10 years hosting corporate and community teams across a wide range of industries and organizations. Every member of your group is essential to the story. In a Breakout escape room, you'll work together to solve problems in an immersive, story-driven world — with real-world benefits for your team. Fun Comes First - From the moment you walk in, your team is here to play, laugh, and celebrate together. Connection Builds Community - Collaboration creates bonds that last beyond the game — whether it's classmates or colleagues. Every Guest is a Main Character - No one gets left behind — every student, coworker, or teammate has a role in the story. We Lead the Way - We take care of the details so you can focus on your team, not the logistics.
